import Ern.MemoryModel.Access.Preserve.Common

/-!
# Access kernel: `transfer` (O4, §63)

Properties of `transfer` (§63 of `specs/ERN_Memory_Model_Specification_v0.1.md`), its
preservation of the kernel invariant `KInv` (§57), of the auxiliary `KAux`
(`transfer_preserves_kAux`), of the auxiliary `HeldAnchored` (`transfer_preserves_heldAnchored`)
and of `I5` (`transfer_preserves_i5`).

* With §63.9 (the destination is usable in the resulting state), `WF3`, `Inv3` and `NoOrphan` are
  preserved (`transfer_preserves_wf3_inv3`). `AnchorOrderHeld` needs more: §63.7 constrains only
  the moved held authorities, and an authority held outside the value whose effective anchor
  moves with it escapes the check (`transfer_preserves_of_dst_usable_fails`, on a state that is not
  built by kernel steps). With the auxiliary `HeldAnchored` (not a clause of §57), `KInv` is
  preserved (`transfer_preserves`).
* A transfer that would close an ownership cycle, and break `KInv`, is rejected by §63.9
  (`transfer_cycle_rejected`).
* The effect and rejection theorems of §63.
-/

namespace Ern.MemoryModel.Access

/-! ## Helpers on options and stacks -/

/-- Reading `OptP` with default `True` on a present value (§38). -/
private theorem optP_true {α : Type} {o : Option α} {P : α → Prop} {y : α} (h : OptP o P True)
    (hy : o = some y) : P y := by
  subst hy; exact h

/-- `OptP` with default `False` holds on a present value (§38). -/
private theorem optP_false_iff {α : Type} {o : Option α} {P : α → Prop} :
    OptP o P False ↔ ∃ y, o = some y ∧ P y := by
  cases o with
  | none => exact ⟨fun h => h.elim, fun ⟨_, h, _⟩ => by cases h⟩
  | some y => exact ⟨fun h => ⟨y, rfl, h⟩, fun ⟨_, h, hy⟩ => by cases h; exact hy⟩

/-- A frame of the stack is its own ancestor (§39). -/
private theorem ancestor_self {F : Frames} {f : Nat} (h : f ∈ F) : ancestor F f f := by
  unfold ancestor
    split at hx
    · simp at hx
    · rcases List.mem_append.1 hx with hx | hx
      · exact i3 q hq' x hx
      · obtain ⟨r, hr, -, hxr⟩ := mem_movedTo.1 hx
        exact hpre.depsValid x (mem_movedDeps_part hr hxr)
  · intro j y hy ya q hq l hl hly
    rw [transfer_A_get] at hy
    obtain ⟨y₀, hy₀, rfl⟩ := Option.map_eq_some_iff.1 hy
    have ya₀ : y₀.active = true := by split at ya <;> exact ya
    have hly₀ : l ∈ y₀.footprint := by split at hly <;> exact hly
    rw [transfer_footprint] at hl
    exact hnd j y₀ hy₀ ya₀ q (fun hu => hq (transfer_usable_fwd hwf hd' hu)) l hl hly₀

/-- An accepted transfer preserves `WF3`, `Inv3` and `NoOrphan` (§57; §63, with §63.9). -/
theorem transfer_preserves_wf3_inv3 {k : K} {s s' : S3} {src dst : Nat} (hinv : KInv s)
    (h : TransferStep k src dst s (.ok s')) : WF3 s' ∧ Inv3 s' ∧ NoOrphan s' := by
  obtain ⟨hpre, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 h
  have hw' := transfer_wf3 hinv.1 hpre
  exact ⟨hw', transfer_inv3 hinv.1 hinv.2.1 hpre, noOrphan_of_wf3 hw'⟩

/-- An accepted transfer preserves the auxiliary `KAux` (`RootHeldConv`, §40, §49.7; §63 `ok`
effect, third item), with no further hypothesis. -/
theorem transfer_preserves_kAux {k : K} {s s' : S3} {src dst : Nat} (haux : KAux s)
    (h : TransferStep k src dst s (.ok s')) : KAux s' := by
  obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 h
  exact transfer_rootHeldConv haux

/-- Auxiliary invariant, not a clause of §57 nor of §63: every active derived
authority held by a usable place is among the anchors of that place (§44). `store` (§65) adds
the stored authority to the anchors of its target, and the `ok` effect of §63 moves an
authority held by a part `r` of the source together with the anchors of `r`. -/
def HeldAnchored (s : S3) : Prop :=
  ∀ (x : Nat) (y : Authority) (q : Nat), s.A[x]? = some y → y.active = true → y.origin ≠ none →
    y.holder = .place q → s.Usable q → x ∈ s.D q

/-- `AnchorOrderHeld` (§44, §54) after an accepted transfer, under `HeldAnchored`: a moved held
authority is checked by §63.7; an unmoved derived one is an anchor of its unmoved holder,
checked by `AnchorOrder` in the resulting state (§63.6); an unmoved root authority is its own
effective anchor, held by the place. -/
private theorem transfer_anchorOrderHeld {k : K} {s : S3} {src dst : Nat} (hwf : WF3 s)
    (hheld : HeldAnchored s) (hpre : TransferPre k s src dst) :
    AnchorOrderHeld (transferEff s src dst) := by
  intro q hq x y hy ya hh
  have hy' := hy
  rw [transfer_A_get] at hy
  obtain ⟨y₀, hy₀, rfl⟩ := Option.map_eq_some_iff.1 hy
  by_cases hm : AnchorMoves s src x
  · have e := hpre.anchorOrderHeld x (List.mem_range.2 (lt_of_getElem? hy₀)) hm q
      (List.mem_range.2 (by rw [← transfer_len s src dst]; exact hq.lt)) hq
    rw [hy'] at e
    exact e ya hh
  · have hmv : ¬ HolderMoves s src y₀.holder := by
      unfold AnchorMoves at hm; rw [hy₀] at hm; exact hm
    have hnh : ¬ heldIn s.P src y₀.holder := by
      cases e : y₀.holder with
      | frame g => simp [heldIn]
      | place p => rw [e] at hmv; exact fun h => hmv (.inl h)
    simp only [hnh, ↓reduceIte] at ya hh hy'
    have hqs : ¬ partOf s.P q src := by rw [hh] at hmv; exact fun h => hmv (.inl h)
    cases ho : y₀.origin with
    | none =>
      have hex : (transferEff s src dst).effAnchor x = x := by
        have : (transferEff s src dst).org x = none := by simp [S3.org, hy', ho]
        simp [S3.effAnchor, S3.ancs, chain_none this]
      obtain ⟨f, hf, hfF⟩ := hq.frameOf
      unfold EffAnchorOK
      rw [hex, hy', pframe_iff.2 hf]
      simp only [OptP, hh, S3.hframe, pframe_iff.2 hf]
      exact ancestor_self hfF
    | some o =>
      have hxq := hheld x y₀ q hy₀ ya (by rw [ho]; exact fun h => by cases h) hh
        (transfer_usable_back hwf hpre.srcUsable hq)
      have hxq' : x ∈ (transferEff s src dst).D q := by
        rw [transfer_D]; simp only [hqs, ↓reduceIte]; exact List.mem_append_left _ hxq
      exact hpre.anchorOrder q hq x hxq'

/-- An accepted transfer preserves `HeldAnchored` (§44; §63 `ok` effect, second and fourth items):
an authority held by a part `r` of the source moves to `corr(r)` together with the anchors of
`r`; the other holders and their anchors are unchanged. -/
theorem transfer_preserves_heldAnchored {k : K} {s s' : S3} {src dst : Nat} (hwf : WF3 s)
    (hheld : HeldAnchored s) (h : TransferStep k src dst s (.ok s')) : HeldAnchored s' := by
  obtain ⟨hpre, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 h
  intro x y q hy ya ho hh hq
  rw [transfer_A_get] at hy
  obtain ⟨y₀, hy₀, rfl⟩ := Option.map_eq_some_iff.1 hy
  have ya₀ : y₀.active = true := by split at ya <;> exact ya
  have ho₀ : y₀.origin ≠ none := by split at ho <;> exact ho
  by_cases hc : heldIn s.P src y₀.holder
  · simp only [hc, ↓reduceIte] at hh
    cases e : y₀.holder with
    | frame _ => rw [e] at hc; exact hc.elim
    | place r =>
      rw [e] at hc hh
      obtain ⟨r', hcr, -⟩ :=
        optP_false_iff.1 (hpre.sameShape.1 r (List.mem_range.2 hc.1) hc)
      simp only [mvTo, hcr, Option.getD_some, Holder.place.injEq] at hh
      subst hh
      have hr' := corr_partOf hwf hpre.dstUsable.lt (r + 1) r r' (Nat.lt_succ_self r) hcr
      have hxr := hheld x y₀ r hy₀ ya₀ ho₀ e
        (usable_of_partOf hwf (r + 1) r src (Nat.lt_succ_self r) hc hpre.srcUsable)
      rw [transfer_D]; simp only [not_partOf_src hwf hpre.disjoint hr', ↓reduceIte]
      exact List.mem_append_right _ (mem_movedTo.2 ⟨r, hc, hcr, hxr⟩)
  · simp only [hc, ↓reduceIte] at hh
    have hqs : ¬ partOf s.P q src := by rw [hh] at hc; exact hc
    have hxq := hheld x y₀ q hy₀ ya₀ ho₀ hh (transfer_usable_back hwf hpre.srcUsable hq)
    rw [transfer_D]; simp only [hqs, ↓reduceIte]
    exact List.mem_append_left _ hxq

/-- On a state satisfying `KInv` and the auxiliary `HeldAnchored`, an accepted transfer preserves
`KInv` (§57; §63). `HeldAnchored` is not a clause of §57: `transfer_preserves_of_dst_usable_fails`
shows that `KInv ∧ KAux` does not suffice on states not built by kernel steps. -/
theorem transfer_preserves {k : K} {s s' : S3} {src dst : Nat} (hinv : KInv s)
    (hheld : HeldAnchored s) (h : TransferStep k src dst s (.ok s')) : KInv s' := by
  obtain ⟨hw', hi', -⟩ := transfer_preserves_wf3_inv3 hinv h
  obtain ⟨hpre, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 h
  exact kInv_of hw' hi' (transfer_anchorOrderHeld hinv.1 hheld hpre)

/-- An accepted transfer preserves `I5` (§57; §63 `ok` effect, §74), from a `WF3` state (§49):
the pinning obligations, the leaves and the footprints are unchanged, and with §63.9 every usable
place stays usable. `WF3` is used only for the last point. -/
theorem transfer_preserves_i5 {k : K} {s s' : S3} {src dst : Nat} (hwf : WF3 s) (h5 : I5 k s)
    (h : TransferStep k src dst s (.ok s')) : I5 k s' := by
  obtain ⟨hpre, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 h
  intro l hlt hleaf hl
  rw [transfer_len] at hlt
  replace hleaf : isLeaf s.P l := by simpa only [isLeaf, transfer_len, transfer_parentOf] using hleaf
  rw [S3.pin_congr (pins_transferEff s src dst)] at hl
  obtain ⟨q, hq, hlq⟩ := h5 l hlt hleaf hl
  exact ⟨q, transfer_usable_fwd hwf hpre.dstUsableAfter hq, by rw [transfer_footprint]; exact hlq⟩

/-! ## §63.9 rejects the ownership-cycle run (§49.8, §54) -/

namespace TransferWitness

/-- Statics of the ownership-cycle counterexample (§47): two leaves owned by frame 0, place 0 and
place 1, both `Init`. -/
def cycStatics : Statics := [((none, none, 0), true), ((none, none, 0), true)]

/-- Initial state of the counterexample (§47). -/
def cyc0 : S3 := S3.init cycStatics

/-- After `alloc` with provider 1 and owner place 0 (§71): place 2 owned by place 0, root
authority 2 held by place 0. -/
def cyc1 : S3 := allocEff cyc0 0 [(none, 0)]

/-- After `alloc` with provider 1 and owner place 2 (§71): place 3 owned by place 2, root
authority 3 held by place 2. -/
def cyc2 : S3 := allocEff cyc1 2 [(none, 0)]

/-- The effect of `transfer(0, 3)` on `cyc2` (§63 `ok` effect): place 2 would be owned by place 3,
which is owned by place 2. -/
def cyc3 : S3 := transferEff cyc2 0 3

/-- `cyc2` is reached from `S3.init cycStatics` by two `alloc` steps (§57, §71). -/
theorem cyc2_reachable : Reachable Examples.K0 cycStatics cyc2 :=
  .step (.step .init (KStep.alloc (pr := 1) (ow := 0) (ls := [(none, 0)])
    (AllocStep.ok (by decide) trivial))) (KStep.alloc (pr := 1) (ow := 2) (ls := [(none, 0)])
    (AllocStep.ok (by decide) trivial))

/-- `cyc2` satisfies `KInv` and `KAux` (§57, §49.7). -/
theorem cyc2_kInv : KInv cyc2 ∧ KAux cyc2 := kInvAux_of_bounded (by decide)

/-- In `cyc3`, places 2 and 3 own each other and are unusable (§40; §63.9 fails); root authority
2 is active, held by the unusable place 3 and covers the leaf of the unusable place 2. -/
theorem cyc3_cycle : ¬ cyc3.Usable 2 ∧ ¬ cyc3.Usable 3 ∧ cyc3.Active 2 ∧
    OptP (cyc3.A[2]?) (fun y => y.holder = .place 3 ∧ 2 ∈ y.footprint) False := by decide

/-- `cyc3` violates holder validity (§49.8), so `WF3`, and `NoDangling` (§54). -/
theorem cyc3_not_wf3_noDangling : ¬ WF3 cyc3 ∧ ¬ NoDangling cyc3 := by
  obtain ⟨hu2, hu3, -, hy⟩ := cyc3_cycle
  obtain ⟨y, hy, hh, hl⟩ := optP_false_iff.1 hy
  have ya : y.active = true := by
    have : OptP (cyc3.A[2]?) (fun y => y.active = true) False := by decide
    rw [hy] at this; exact this
  refine ⟨fun hw => ?_, fun hnd => ?_⟩
  · have := hw.holders 2 y hy ya
    rw [hh] at this; exact hu3 this
  · exact hnd 2 y hy ya 2 hu2 2 (by decide) hl

end TransferWitness

open TransferWitness in
/-- The ownership-cycle run of §63 is rejected by §63.9 alone: under a contract with `DDSound`
(§80), in a reachable state satisfying `KInv ∧ KAux`, `transfer(0, 3)` satisfies §63.1–§63.8, its
destination is not usable in the resulting state (§63.9 fails), so the step is rejected; that
state would violate `KInv` (holder validity §49.8, `cyc3_not_wf3_noDangling`). -/
theorem transfer_cycle_rejected : DDSound Examples.K0 ∧ Reachable Examples.K0 cycStatics cyc2 ∧
    KInv cyc2 ∧ KAux cyc2 ∧
    (cyc2.Usable 0 ∧ cyc2.Usable 3 ∧ HasRight cyc2 .modify 0 ∧ HasRight cyc2 .modify 3 ∧
      SameShape cyc2.P 0 3 ∧ (∀ l ∈ footprint cyc2.P 0, cyc2.I l = .init) ∧
      (∀ l ∈ footprint cyc2.P 3, cyc2.I l ≠ .init) ∧ ¬ overlap cyc2.P 0 3 ∧
      (∃ g ∈ List.range cyc2.A.length, Grounds cyc2 .modify 0 g ∧
        ∀ j ∈ List.range cyc2.A.length, ActiveDerivedOutside cyc2 0 j → RightChain cyc2 g j) ∧
      (∀ l ∈ footprint cyc2.P 0, ¬ Examples.K0.Pinned l ∧ cyc2.pin l = false) ∧
      (∀ x ∈ movedDeps cyc2 0, cyc2.Active x) ∧ AnchorOrder cyc3 ∧
      (∀ x ∈ List.range cyc2.A.length, AnchorMoves cyc2 0 x →
        ∀ q ∈ List.range cyc2.P.length, cyc3.Usable q →
          OptP (cyc3.A[x]?) (fun y => y.active = true → y.holder = .place q →
            EffAnchorOK cyc3 x (cyc3.pframe q)) True) ∧
      NoLocalSelfLock cyc2 0 3) ∧
    ¬ cyc3.Usable 3 ∧ TransferStep Examples.K0 0 3 cyc2 .reject ∧ ¬ KInv cyc3 :=
  ⟨fun _ _ h => (h : False).elim, cyc2_reachable, cyc2_kInv.1, cyc2_kInv.2, by decide,
    cyc3_cycle.2.1, .reject fun hpre => cyc3_cycle.2.1 hpre.dstUsableAfter,
    fun h => cyc3_not_wf3_noDangling.1 h.1⟩

/-! ## `KInv ∧ KAux` does not suffice without `HeldAnchored` (§44, §63.7)

The transfer below satisfies every precondition of §63, §63.9 included. §63.7 checks
`AnchorOrderHeld` only for the moved held authorities. In `ahx`, the derived authority 6 is held
by place 2, outside the transferred value, without being among its anchors (`HeldAnchored`
fails), and its effective anchor, the root 3 held by the source, moves with the value to a
younger frame. The state is not built by kernel steps: in such runs a derived
authority is held by a place only through `store` (§65), which also anchors it there. -/

namespace TransferWitness

/-- A state satisfying `KInv ∧ KAux` (§57, §49.7), not reached by kernel steps: frames 1 (current)
and 0; place 0 owned by frame 0; source place 1 owned by place 0, `Init`; place 2 owned by
frame 0; place 3 owned by the source; destination place 4 owned by frame 1. Authorities 0–4 are
the roots of places 0–4; authority 5, derived from 0, gives frame 1 `Modify` on place 0 and,
through it, on the source; authority 6, derived from the root 3, is held by place 2, with no
anchor anywhere. -/
def ahx : S3 where
  F := [1, 0]
  nF := 2
  P := [⟨none, .frame 0, 0⟩, ⟨none, .place 0, 0⟩, ⟨none, .frame 0, 0⟩, ⟨none, .place 1, 0⟩,
    ⟨none, .frame 1, 0⟩]
  I := fun l => if l = 1 then .init else .uninit
  A := [⟨.modify, none, [0], .frame 0, true⟩, ⟨.modify, none, [1], .place 0, true⟩,
    ⟨.modify, none, [2], .frame 0, true⟩, ⟨.modify, none, [3], .place 1, true⟩,
    ⟨.modify, none, [4], .frame 1, true⟩, ⟨.modify, some 0, [0], .frame 1, true⟩,
    ⟨.modify, some 3, [3], .place 2, true⟩]
  D := fun _ => []
  dead := fun _ => false
  pins := []

/-- `transfer(1, 4)` from `ahx` (§63, `ok` effect). -/
def ahx' : S3 := transferEff ahx 1 4

end TransferWitness

open TransferWitness in
/-- From a state satisfying `KInv ∧ KAux`, an accepted transfer (§63, its destination usable in
the resulting state by §63.9) can still break `AnchorOrderHeld` (§44, §54): in `ahx'`, authority
6 is held by place 2 of frame 0 and its effective anchor, the root 3, is now held by the
destination in frame 1. `HeldAnchored` fails in `ahx`. -/
theorem transfer_preserves_of_dst_usable_fails : ∃ s s', KInv s ∧ KAux s ∧ ¬ HeldAnchored s ∧
    TransferStep Examples.K0 1 4 s (.ok s') ∧ s'.Usable 4 ∧ ¬ AnchorOrderHeld s' := by
  have hk := kInvAux_of_bounded (s := ahx) (by decide)
  refine ⟨ahx, ahx', hk.1, hk.2, fun h => ?_, .ok (by decide), by decide, by decide⟩
  have := h 6 ⟨.modify, some 3, [3], .place 2, true⟩ 2 rfl rfl (by simp) rfl (by decide)
  simp [ahx] at this

/-! ## Effects and rejections of `transfer` (§63) -/

/-- Determinism of `transfer` (§58, §63): one outcome per state. -/
theorem transfer_det {k : K} {src dst : Nat} {s : S3} {o₁ o₂ : Outcome3 S3}
    (h₁ : TransferStep k src dst s o₁) (h₂ : TransferStep k src dst s o₂) : o₁ = o₂ :=
  Guarded.det h₁ h₂

/-- §63 `ok` effect, second and third items: after an accepted transfer, an authority held by a
part `r` of the source is held by the corresponding part `corr(r)` of the destination, not
indiscriminately by the destination root; a place owned by `r` is owned by `corr(r)`. -/
theorem transfer_to_corresponding_parts {k : K} {s s' : S3} {src dst : Nat} (hwf : WF3 s)
    (h : TransferStep k src dst s (.ok s')) {r : Nat} (hr : partOf s.P r src) :
    ∃ r', corr s.P src dst r = some r' ∧ partOf s.P r' dst ∧
      (∀ (b : Nat) (y : Authority), s.A[b]? = some y → y.holder = .place r →
        s'.A[b]? = some { y with holder := .place r' }) ∧
      (∀ (q : Nat) (pl : Place), s.P[q]? = some pl → pl.owner = .place r →
        s'.P[q]? = some { pl with owner := .place r' }) := by

import Ern.MemoryModel.Access.Basic

/-!
# Access kernel: operations O1–O16

The sixteen kernel operations of `specs/ERN_Memory_Model_Specification_v0.1.md` §60–§75. Each
operation has a precondition structure with one named field per clause item (or per condition of
an item), each field citing its clause; a `Decidable` instance; an effect function; and a step
relation over `Outcome3` (§58). Every operation except `alloc` is `Guarded` (`ok` or `reject`);
`alloc` may also `fail` (§58, §71). `KStep` is the union of their `ok` transitions.
-/

namespace Ern.MemoryModel.Access

/-- `mapI f i l` applies `f` to each element of `l` with its index counted from `i` (used by the
effects of §72 and §73). -/
def mapI {α β : Type} (f : Nat → α → β) : Nat → List α → List β
  | _, [] => []
  | i, a :: l => f i a :: mapI f (i + 1) l

/-! ## O1 `derive` (§60) -/

/-- Effect of `derive(source, region, mode)` (§60, `ok` effect): a new active authority of fresh
identity, origin `src`, mode `m`, footprint `region`, held by the current frame. -/
def deriveEff (s : S3) (src : Nat) (region : List Nat) (m : Mode) : S3 :=
  s.addAuth ⟨m, some src, region, .frame s.top, true⟩

/-- Preconditions of `derive` (§60). -/
structure DerivePre (s : S3) (src : Nat) (region : List Nat) (m : Mode) : Prop where
  /-- §60.1: `source` is active. -/
  active : s.Active src
  /-- §60.1: `ExercisableAt(s, source, mode)`. -/
  exercisable : s.ExercisableAt src m
  /-- §60.1: every authority of the origin chain of `source`, its effective anchor included, is
  active. -/
  chainActive : ∀ x ∈ s.ancs src, s.Active x
  /-- §60.2: the leaves of `region` exist. -/
  leaves : ∀ l ∈ region, l < s.P.length ∧ isLeaf s.P l
  /-- §60.2: the leaves of `region` belong to the footprint of `source`. -/
  within : ∀ l ∈ region, l ∈ s.afp src
  /-- §60.2: `mode` does not exceed the effective right of `source` on these leaves. -/
  modeOK : ∀ l ∈ region, Allows (effective s src l) m
  /-- §60.3: the addition preserves I1 (§50): an active authority outside the origin chain of the
  new one and sharing a leaf of `region` has own mode `Observe`, and so has the request. -/
  exclusive : ∀ b ∈ List.range s.A.length, OptP (s.A[b]?) (fun y => y.active = true →
    b ∉ src :: s.ancs src → (∃ l ∈ region, l ∈ y.footprint) → y.mode = .observe ∧ m = .observe)
    True
  /-- §60.4: the new holding frame is the live current frame. -/
  frameLive : s.top ∈ s.F

/-- Decidability of the preconditions of `derive` (§60). -/
instance (s : S3) (src : Nat) (region : List Nat) (m : Mode) :
    Decidable (DerivePre s src region m) :=
  decidable_of_iff (s.Active src ∧ s.ExercisableAt src m ∧ (∀ x ∈ s.ancs src, s.Active x) ∧
    (∀ l ∈ region, l < s.P.length ∧ isLeaf s.P l) ∧ (∀ l ∈ region, l ∈ s.afp src) ∧
    (∀ l ∈ region, Allows (effective s src l) m) ∧
    (∀ b ∈ List.range s.A.length, OptP (s.A[b]?) (fun y => y.active = true →
      b ∉ src :: s.ancs src → (∃ l ∈ region, l ∈ y.footprint) → y.mode = .observe ∧ m = .observe)
      True) ∧
    s.top ∈ s.F)
    ⟨fun ⟨a, b, c, d, e, f, g, h⟩ => ⟨a, b, c, d, e, f, g, h⟩,
     fun ⟨a, b, c, d, e, f, g, h⟩ => ⟨a, b, c, d, e, f, g, h⟩⟩

/-- `derive` as a relation (§60). -/
def DeriveStep (src : Nat) (region : List Nat) (m : Mode) (s : S3) : Outcome3 S3 → Prop :=
  Guarded (DerivePre s src region m) (deriveEff s src region m)

/-! ## O2 `split` (§61) -/

/-- Effect of `split(source, regions)` (§61, `ok` effect): one active derived `Modify` authority
per region, held by the current frame. -/
def splitEff (s : S3) (src : Nat) (rs : List (List Nat)) : S3 :=
  { s with A := s.A ++ rs.map fun r => ⟨.modify, some src, r, .frame s.top, true⟩ }

/-- Exclusive right already distributed by `src` on leaf `p` (§61.3): an active `Modify`
descendant of `src` covering `p`. -/
def DistribExcl (s : S3) (src j p : Nat) : Prop :=
  OptP (s.A[j]?) (fun y => y.active = true ∧ src ∈ s.ancs j ∧ p ∈ y.footprint ∧ y.mode = .modify)
    False

/-- Decidability of `DistribExcl` (§61.3). -/
instance (s : S3) (src j p : Nat) : Decidable (DistribExcl s src j p) := by
  unfold DistribExcl; infer_instance

/-- Preconditions of `split` (§61). §61.4 is not a precondition (see the note of §61). -/
structure SplitPre (k : K) (s : S3) (src : Nat) (rs : List (List Nat)) : Prop where
  /-- §61.1: `source` is active. -/
  active : s.Active src
  /-- §61.1: `source` is exercisable by the current frame in `Modify`. -/
  exercisable : s.ExercisableAt src .modify
  /-- §61.1: sufficient modification rights: effective `Modify` on every leaf of the regions. -/
  modifyOn : ∀ r ∈ rs, ∀ p ∈ r, effective s src p = some .modify
  /-- §61.2: each region lies within the available footprint of `source`. -/
  within : ∀ r ∈ rs, ∀ p ∈ r, p ∈ s.afp src ∧ effective s src p ≠ none
  /-- §61.3: regions are pairwise disjoint, structurally or by `K.DeclaredDisjoint`. -/
  disjoint : rs.Pairwise (fun r r' => (∀ l ∈ r, l ∉ r') ∨ k.DeclaredDisjoint r r')
  /-- §61.3: no exclusive right already distributed is overlapped. -/
  notDistributed : ∀ r ∈ rs, ∀ p ∈ r, ∀ j ∈ List.range s.A.length, ¬ DistribExcl s src j p

/-- Decidability of the preconditions of `split` (§61). -/
instance (k : K) [∀ r r', Decidable (k.DeclaredDisjoint r r')] (s : S3) (src : Nat)
    (rs : List (List Nat)) : Decidable (SplitPre k s src rs) :=
  decidable_of_iff (s.Active src ∧ s.ExercisableAt src .modify ∧
    (∀ r ∈ rs, ∀ p ∈ r, effective s src p = some .modify) ∧
    (∀ r ∈ rs, ∀ p ∈ r, p ∈ s.afp src ∧ effective s src p ≠ none) ∧
    rs.Pairwise (fun r r' => (∀ l ∈ r, l ∉ r') ∨ k.DeclaredDisjoint r r') ∧
    (∀ r ∈ rs, ∀ p ∈ r, ∀ j ∈ List.range s.A.length, ¬ DistribExcl s src j p))
    ⟨fun ⟨a, b, c, d, e, f⟩ => ⟨a, b, c, d, e, f⟩, fun ⟨a, b, c, d, e, f⟩ => ⟨a, b, c, d, e, f⟩⟩

/-- `split` as a relation (§61). -/
def SplitStep (k : K) (src : Nat) (rs : List (List Nat)) (s : S3) : Outcome3 S3 → Prop :=
  Guarded (SplitPre k s src rs) (splitEff s src rs)

/-! ## O3 `release` (§62) -/

/-- Effect of `release(authority)` (§62, `ok` effect): the authority becomes inactive and leaves
the anchors of its holding place. -/
def releaseEff (s : S3) (a : Nat) : S3 := match s.A[a]? with
  | some x => { s with
      A := s.A.set a { x with active := false }
      D := fun q => if x.holder = .place q then (s.D q).filter (· != a) else s.D q }
  | none => s

/-- Right of the current frame on a holder (§62.2): the current frame itself, or a place on which
the current frame has exercisable `Modify`. -/
def HolderRight (s : S3) : Holder → Prop
  | .frame f => f = s.top
  | .place p => HasRight s .modify p

/-- Decidability of `HolderRight` (§62.2). -/
instance (s : S3) (h : Holder) : Decidable (HolderRight s h) := by
  cases h <;> unfold HolderRight <;> infer_instance

/-- Preconditions of `release` (§62). §62.5 is not represented. -/
structure ReleasePre (s : S3) (a : Nat) : Prop where
  /-- §62.1: the authority is active. -/
  active : s.Active a
  /-- §62.1: the authority is derived. -/
  derived : OptP (s.A[a]?) (fun y => y.origin ≠ none) False
  /-- §62.2: it is held by the current frame or by a place with exercisable `Modify`. -/
  holderRight : OptP (s.A[a]?) (fun y => HolderRight s y.holder) False
  /-- §62.3: no active descendant. -/
  noActiveDesc : ∀ j ∈ List.range s.A.length, a ∈ s.ancs j → ¬ s.Active j
  /-- §62.3, §62.4: no usable place keeps `a` as anchor, except its holding place. -/
  anchors : ∀ q ∈ List.range s.P.length, s.Usable q → a ∈ s.D q →
    (s.A[a]?).map (·.holder) = some (.place q)

/-- Decidability of the preconditions of `release` (§62). -/
instance (s : S3) (a : Nat) : Decidable (ReleasePre s a) :=
  decidable_of_iff (s.Active a ∧ OptP (s.A[a]?) (fun y => y.origin ≠ none) False ∧
    OptP (s.A[a]?) (fun y => HolderRight s y.holder) False ∧
    (∀ j ∈ List.range s.A.length, a ∈ s.ancs j → ¬ s.Active j) ∧
    (∀ q ∈ List.range s.P.length, s.Usable q → a ∈ s.D q →
      (s.A[a]?).map (·.holder) = some (.place q)))
    ⟨fun ⟨a, b, c, d, e⟩ => ⟨a, b, c, d, e⟩, fun ⟨a, b, c, d, e⟩ => ⟨a, b, c, d, e⟩⟩

/-- `release` as a relation (§62). -/
def ReleaseStep (a : Nat) (s : S3) : Outcome3 S3 → Prop :=
  Guarded (ReleasePre s a) (releaseEff s a)

/-! ## O4 `transfer` (§63) -/

/-- Children of place `x` in index order (§63.2). -/
def kids (P : List Place) (x : Nat) : List Nat :=
  (List.range P.length).filter fun r => decide (parentOf P r = some x)

/-- Position of `r` in a list, its length if absent (§63.2). -/
def posIn (r : Nat) : List Nat → Nat
  | [] => 0
  | a :: l => if a = r then 0 else posIn r l + 1

/-- `corr(r)` within `n` steps (§63.2): `dst` for `src`; for another part, the child at the same
position of the place corresponding to its parent. -/
def corrF (P : List Place) (src dst : Nat) : Nat → Nat → Option Nat
  | 0, r => if r = src then some dst else none
  | n + 1, r => if r = src then some dst else
      match parentOf P r with
      | some p => if p < r then
          (corrF P src dst n p).bind fun p' => (kids P p')[posIn r (kids P p)]? else none
      | none => none

/-- `corr(r)` (§63.2, §63.8): the part of `dst` corresponding to the part `r` of `src`. -/
def corr (P : List Place) (src dst r : Nat) : Option Nat := corrF P src dst r r

/-- Same shape of ordered subtrees (§63.2): every part of `src` has a corresponding part of `dst`
with as many children, and every part of `dst` corresponds to a part of `src`. -/
def SameShape (P : List Place) (src dst : Nat) : Prop :=
  (∀ r ∈ List.range P.length, partOf P r src →
    OptP (corr P src dst r) (fun r' => (kids P r').length = (kids P r).length) False) ∧
  ∀ z ∈ List.range P.length, partOf P z dst →
    ∃ r ∈ List.range P.length, partOf P r src ∧ corr P src dst r = some z

/-- Decidability of `SameShape` (§63.2). -/
instance (P : List Place) (src dst : Nat) : Decidable (SameShape P src dst) := by
  unfold SameShape; infer_instance

/-- Holder within the value at `q` (§63, §69, §70): `q` or one of its parts. -/
def heldIn (P : List Place) (q : Nat) : Holder → Prop
  | .place r => partOf P r q
  | .frame _ => False

/-- Decidability of `heldIn` (§63). -/
instance (P : List Place) (q : Nat) (h : Holder) : Decidable (heldIn P q h) := by
  cases h <;> unfold heldIn <;> infer_instance

/-- Holder `h` after the transfer of `src` to `dst` (§63, `ok` effect): part `r` of `src` becomes
`corr(r)`. Applied to holders within `src` only. -/
def mvTo (P : List Place) (src dst : Nat) : Holder → Holder
  | .place r => .place ((corr P src dst r).getD dst)
  | .frame f => .frame f

/-- Anchors moved onto place `q` by the transfer (§63, `ok` effect, fourth item): those of every
part `r` of `src` with `corr(r) = q`. -/
def movedTo (s : S3) (src dst q : Nat) : List Nat :=
  ((List.range s.P.length).filter fun r =>
    decide (partOf s.P r src ∧ corr s.P src dst r = some q)).flatMap s.D

/-- Effect of `transfer(source, destination)` (§63, `ok` effect): source leaves `Moved`,
destination leaves `Init`; authorities held by part `r` of `src`, and places owned by `r`, move
to `corr(r)`; the anchors of `r` follow `corr(r)`. -/
def transferEff (s : S3) (src dst : Nat) : S3 :=
  { s with
    P := s.P.map fun pl =>
      if heldIn s.P src pl.owner then { pl with owner := mvTo s.P src dst pl.owner } else pl
    I := fun l => if l ∈ footprint s.P dst then .init
      else if l ∈ footprint s.P src then .moved else s.I l
    D := fun q => if partOf s.P q src then [] else s.D q ++ movedTo s src dst q
    A := s.A.map fun y =>
      if heldIn s.P src y.holder then { y with holder := mvTo s.P src dst y.holder } else y }

/-- Active derived authority covering a leaf of `src` and not held within it (§63.4). -/
def ActiveDerivedOutside (s : S3) (src j : Nat) : Prop :=
  OptP (s.A[j]?) (fun y => y.active = true ∧ y.origin ≠ none ∧ ¬ heldIn s.P src y.holder ∧
    ∃ l ∈ y.footprint, l ∈ footprint s.P src) False

/-- Decidability of `ActiveDerivedOutside` (§63.4). -/
instance (s : S3) (src j : Nat) : Decidable (ActiveDerivedOutside s src j) := by
  unfold ActiveDerivedOutside; infer_instance

/-- The holder moves with the value at `src` (§63.6, §63.7): a part of `src` or storage it owns,
transitively. -/
def HolderMoves (s : S3) (src : Nat) : Holder → Prop
  | .place p => partOf s.P p src ∨ OwnedIn s.P src p
  | .frame _ => False

/-- Decidability of `HolderMoves` (§63.7). -/
instance (s : S3) (src : Nat) (h : Holder) : Decidable (HolderMoves s src h) := by
  cases h <;> unfold HolderMoves <;> infer_instance

/-- Authority `x` is a moved held authority (§63.7): its holder moves with the value at `src`. -/
def AnchorMoves (s : S3) (src x : Nat) : Prop :=
  OptP (s.A[x]?) (fun y => HolderMoves s src y.holder) False

/-- Decidability of `AnchorMoves` (§63.7). -/
instance (s : S3) (src x : Nat) : Decidable (AnchorMoves s src x) := by
  unfold AnchorMoves; infer_instance

/-- Dependencies of the usable places following the value at `src` (§63.6): the anchors of its
parts and of the usable storage it owns, transitively. -/
def movedDeps (s : S3) (src : Nat) : List Nat :=
  ((List.range s.P.length).filter fun q =>
    decide (partOf s.P q src ∨ (OwnedIn s.P src q ∧ s.Usable q))).flatMap s.D

/-- Leaves of a holder (§63.8): those of a place, none for a frame. -/
def holderLeaves (s : S3) : Holder → List Nat
  | .place p => footprint s.P p
  | .frame _ => []

/-- Authority `a` is active and covers a leaf of its own holder (§63.8). -/
def SelfLock (s : S3) (a : Nat) : Prop :=
  OptP (s.A[a]?) (fun y => y.active = true ∧ ∃ l ∈ y.footprint, l ∈ holderLeaves s y.holder) False

/-- Decidability of `SelfLock` (§63.8). -/
instance (s : S3) (a : Nat) : Decidable (SelfLock s a) := by unfold SelfLock; infer_instance

/-- Local self-blocking prevention (§63.8): no authority held before the step within `src` covers,
in the resulting state, a leaf of its new holder `corr(r)`. -/
def NoLocalSelfLock (s : S3) (src dst : Nat) : Prop :=
  ∀ j ∈ List.range s.A.length, OptP (s.A[j]?) (fun y => heldIn s.P src y.holder) False →
    ¬ SelfLock (transferEff s src dst) j

/-- Decidability of `NoLocalSelfLock` (§63.8). -/
instance (s : S3) (src dst : Nat) : Decidable (NoLocalSelfLock s src dst) := by
  unfold NoLocalSelfLock; infer_instance

/-- Preconditions of `transfer` (§63). -/
structure TransferPre (k : K) (s : S3) (src dst : Nat) : Prop where
  /-- §63.1: `source` is usable. -/
  srcUsable : s.Usable src
  /-- §63.1: `destination` is usable. -/
  dstUsable : s.Usable dst
  /-- §63.1: exercisable `Modify` over the source. -/
  srcRight : HasRight s .modify src
  /-- §63.1: exercisable `Modify` over the destination. -/
  dstRight : HasRight s .modify dst
  /-- §63.2: same shape of ordered subtrees. -/
  sameShape : SameShape s.P src dst
  /-- §63.3: all source leaves are `Init`. -/
  srcInit : ∀ l ∈ footprint s.P src, s.I l = .init
  /-- §63.3: no destination leaf is `Init`. -/
  dstNotInit : ∀ l ∈ footprint s.P dst, s.I l ≠ .init
  /-- §63.3: source and destination footprints are disjoint. -/
  disjoint : ¬ overlap s.P src dst
  /-- §63.4: no active derived authority covers a source leaf from outside the source, except the
  authorities through which the step exercises its `Modify` right over the source: some authority
  grounding that right and its origin chain. -/
  noOutsideDerived : ∃ g ∈ List.range s.A.length, Grounds s .modify src g ∧
    ∀ j ∈ List.range s.A.length, ActiveDerivedOutside s src j → RightChain s g j
  /-- §63.5: no in-place source leaf is pinned, statically or dynamically. -/
  notPinned : ∀ l ∈ footprint s.P src, ¬ k.Pinned l ∧ s.pin l = false
  /-- §63.6: dependencies of the usable places following the value are valid. -/
  depsValid : ∀ x ∈ movedDeps s src, s.Active x
  /-- §63.6: `AnchorOrder` in the resulting state. -/
  anchorOrder : AnchorOrder (transferEff s src dst)
  /-- §63.7: every moved held authority satisfies `AnchorOrderHeld` in the resulting state. -/
  anchorOrderHeld : ∀ x ∈ List.range s.A.length, AnchorMoves s src x →
    ∀ q ∈ List.range s.P.length, (transferEff s src dst).Usable q →
      OptP ((transferEff s src dst).A[x]?) (fun y => y.active = true → y.holder = .place q →
        EffAnchorOK (transferEff s src dst) x ((transferEff s src dst).pframe q)) True
  /-- §63.8: local self-blocking prevention. -/
  noSelfLock : NoLocalSelfLock s src dst
  /-- §63.9: `destination` is usable in the resulting state. -/
  dstUsableAfter : (transferEff s src dst).Usable dst

/-- Decidability of the preconditions of `transfer` (§63). -/
instance (k : K) [DecidablePred k.Pinned] (s : S3) (src dst : Nat) :
    Decidable (TransferPre k s src dst) :=
  decidable_of_iff (s.Usable src ∧ s.Usable dst ∧ HasRight s .modify src ∧
    HasRight s .modify dst ∧ SameShape s.P src dst ∧ (∀ l ∈ footprint s.P src, s.I l = .init) ∧
    (∀ l ∈ footprint s.P dst, s.I l ≠ .init) ∧ ¬ overlap s.P src dst ∧
    (∃ g ∈ List.range s.A.length, Grounds s .modify src g ∧
      ∀ j ∈ List.range s.A.length, ActiveDerivedOutside s src j → RightChain s g j) ∧
    (∀ l ∈ footprint s.P src, ¬ k.Pinned l ∧ s.pin l = false) ∧
    (∀ x ∈ movedDeps s src, s.Active x) ∧ AnchorOrder (transferEff s src dst) ∧
    (∀ x ∈ List.range s.A.length, AnchorMoves s src x →
      ∀ q ∈ List.range s.P.length, (transferEff s src dst).Usable q →
        OptP ((transferEff s src dst).A[x]?) (fun y => y.active = true → y.holder = .place q →
          EffAnchorOK (transferEff s src dst) x ((transferEff s src dst).pframe q)) True) ∧
    NoLocalSelfLock s src dst ∧ (transferEff s src dst).Usable dst)
    ⟨fun ⟨a, b, c, d, e, f, g, h, i, j, l, m, n, o, p⟩ =>
      ⟨a, b, c, d, e, f, g, h, i, j, l, m, n, o, p⟩,
     fun ⟨a, b, c, d, e, f, g, h, i, j, l, m, n, o, p⟩ =>
      ⟨a, b, c, d, e, f, g, h, i, j, l, m, n, o, p⟩⟩

/-- `transfer` as a relation (§63). -/
def TransferStep (k : K) (src dst : Nat) (s : S3) : Outcome3 S3 → Prop :=
  Guarded (TransferPre k s src dst) (transferEff s src dst)

# XIV. Arenas and Collective Invalidation — Reference Abstraction

An arena is a **library abstraction**, not a memory-kernel primitive. Operations O17 through O19 are **derived** from operations O1 through O16 and abstraction-specific metadata: `newArena` registers an administration without modifying the kernel; `issue` performs `split` followed by `store` (after checking availability); `reset` performs a `Modify` derivation over all storage—through `derive` or `split`—then `release`, before restoring availability. Their contract below is **normative for the standard-library arena** until Spec 10 takes responsibility for it. It authorizes neither new permissions nor an additional access machine. Arena entries (Section 46) constitute the abstract state of this administration; the guard in Section 56 belongs to its consistency contract. The contracts of `HandlePool` and `DataStack` belong to their library abstractions and are not defined here.

## 76. O17 — Creation of an Administered Arena

**Preconditions**

1. `storage` is an existing, usable place under exercisable `Modify` by the current frame. It may be local, static, allocated, or a block issued by a previous arena.
2. `internal` is explicitly named by the caller, exists, is active, has own mode `Modify`, and `ExercisableAt(s,internal,Modify)` holds.
3. `internal` is **held by a place**: that place is the arena value; `footprint(internal) = footprint(storage)`.
4. **Unified administration guard (Section 56):** no **live** administrative abstraction, whether an arena or a library instance such as a handle pool, already uses this `internal` identity. The relevant registries of library administrations are consulted before registration. Two distinct identities may cover common leaves: this is not in itself grounds for rejection.
5. All leaves of the arena value holding `internal` are already `Init`; construction does not initialize them implicitly.
6. Dependency, holder, storage, and administration relations respect, in the resulting state, `WF3`, I1, `AnchorOrder`, and `AnchorOrderHeld` over the whole kernel state, and the new entry satisfies `ArenaInv` (Section 55).

**`ok` effect:** A live entry `{storage, internal, available, issued}` is added; the initial `available` set represents the administered storage, and `issued` is initially empty. Registering the entry fabricates no place, access right, or `Init` state. **Other outcome:** `reject`.

The identity of `internal`, not the index of `storage`, is the key to preventing duplication of live administrations. No global constraint requires footprints of live arenas to be pairwise disjoint.

## 77. O18 — Issuing an Arena Block

**Static preconditions**

1. The `arena` entry exists and is live; `internal` is active. `MetaRight` requires exercisable `Modify` over the arena value holding `internal` (Section 36). Mutation of metadata through `writeShared` alone does not satisfy this condition.
2. `region` belongs to the administered storage; `destination` is a usable **leaf** holding no active authority; the destination can legally receive the block value in mode `Modify`. The fact that `destination` is already `Init` is not in itself grounds for rejection, in accordance with O8.2.
   **Local self-blocking prevention: leaf `destination` is not in `region`, including when the region is declared available.** This condition is static and is checked before an availability `fail`.
3. Applicable **static** validity and non-escape restrictions for the destination are satisfied. The `AnchorOrder` check depending on the new anchor is performed on the **simulated resulting state**, after the availability check described in point 4; it cannot turn an unavailable issuance (`fail`) into `reject`.

**Availability and exercisability checks**

4. If static conditions hold but **at least one leaf of `region` does not belong to `available`**, the operation produces **`fail` and leaves the entire state unchanged**. The empty region is always available. An unavailable region does not permit a prior static rejection to be bypassed.
5. If the region is available, the effective mode of `internal` on that region must permit `Modify`; otherwise the outcome is `reject`.
6. The simulated result must satisfy `AnchorOrderHeld` **in the resulting state**; moreover, **in that resulting state, `destination` must remain under exercisable `Modify` by the current frame**, in accordance with O8.5. Issuance into a value with a longer lifetime than a local anchor is not made valid merely by storing it in the caller.

**`ok` effect:** A block authority of fresh identity, derived from `internal` and of mode `Modify`, is issued for the region; it is held by `destination`, which receives the corresponding anchor. The leaves of the region leave `available`, and the issuance is added to `issued` with its authority. **Only leaf `destination` becomes `Init`**; no other leaf of the arena value changes initialization. Previous issuances remain intact and valid. Issuance does not automatically install anchors on third-party values: they must use their lawful dependency mechanisms.

**Outcomes:** `ok`, `fail` (region unavailable after static validation), `reject` (static rule, effective right, or anchoring not satisfied). The destination may be a leaf of the arena value itself: its initialization then constitutes **an explicit write to that destination**, not implicit initialization of the entire arena value's metadata.

## 78. O19 — Collective Arena Reset

**Preconditions**

1. The entry exists and is live. **`MetaRight(s,arena)` requires exercisable `Modify` over the arena value**, in accordance with Section 36. `writeShared` over metadata alone, even when legal, does not replace such exercise. `internal` and the arena's other restrictions remain valid.
2. **No active authority derived from `internal` covers a leaf of the administered storage.** A derived authority with an empty footprint does not, by itself, block `reset`.
3. No still-usable place depends, directly or transitively, on an anchor in the **strict origin subtree of `internal`** (`internal` itself is excluded) that covers a leaf of the administered storage. Under precondition 2 and invariant I3, this condition follows from the absence of active descendants covering the storage, and remains explicit in the abstraction contract. Validity obligations of other nested arenas remain satisfied.

**`ok` effect:** All **leaves** of the administered storage become available again, and the issuance list is cleared under the arena contract. No still-active derived authority covering those leaves may remain, by precondition 2; an empty-footprint derivative may remain active without designating any recycled leaf. **No leaf is made `Init` by `reset`**, including in the arena value. **Other outcome:** `reject`.

Safe reuse after `reset` requires that previous issuances **covering recycled leaves**, and the dependencies on which their validity rests, have effectively ceased preventing their reuse. Any active empty-footprint derivatives cover none of those leaves. A historically issued region does not remain permanently unavailable solely for that reason.

# XV. Transitive Dependencies, Returns, and Value Behavior

Dependent values may survive transfers and calls only if the required anchors and rights remain valid. Second-class access does not imply an arbitrary persistent reference.

## 79. Non-Escaping Values and Returns

The second-class nature of access authorities does not prohibit constructing a value carrying a derived authority or returning a result dependent on a caller-owned resource. What is prohibited is artificially extending the validity of a local origin.

A typical scenario is:

```text
arena = create_arena()
buffer = create_buffer(arena)
use(buffer)
endUse(buffer)       // or equivalent release of its dependent rights
arena.reset()
```

The scenario is permitted when:

1. the call receives and exercises valid authorities over the arena;
2. issuance supplies a block disjoint from live issuances;
3. the result value is anchored to the rights actually required;
4. its transfer to the caller respects `SameShape`, holders, `AnchorOrder`, and `AnchorOrderHeld`;
5. `exitFrame` can reanchor surviving authorities without using a dead local root;
6. `reset` is rejected while the dependent result or a block authority remains active, then becomes permitted after those rights have effectively ended.

A “non-escaping” value is therefore not necessarily confined to the frame in which it was created. It may survive a function when it depends on a caller anchor, without extending dead local storage. This result does **not** imply strong protection of all parameter authorities throughout the entire invocation: the historical interpretation of reborrows and this property are deferred to Spec 3.

Properties of transfer between threads and shareability do not follow from this sequential model alone. They depend on external resources, contained authorities, anchors, confinement restrictions, and the concurrency model of Spec 2.

# XVI. External Contracts and Interfaces with Other Specifications

Declarative contracts create no rights. Their satisfaction is an obligation of the language, typing, implementation, or a safe abstraction, according to the nature of each contract.

## 80. Parametric Contracts of the Access Discipline

A contract `K` parameterizes rules of the access discipline without fabricating permissions. A safe abstraction using part of `K` must prove or fulfill the corresponding obligation; an unestablished precondition is not a language guarantee.

| Contract | External obligation |
|---|---|
| `DeclaredDisjoint` | `DDSound(K)`: no falsely declared disjoint region when leaves can overlap |
| `Pinned` | I5, prohibition of incompatible physical moves; `StaticPinnedBottom` for pinned statics |
| `SharedMutable` | Applicable shared-mutation discipline, with correct rights and synchronization |
| `ExternalDone` | External use of storage has ended when `unpin` is permitted |
| `Deallocable` | The place belongs to a unit that can actually be freed |
| `FreeCompat` | Opaque deallocation authority is compatible with the unit being freed |
| `Satisfiable` | The provider can satisfy the requested shape **in the current state** |

Structural conditions of `free`, dependencies, and the derived library `reset` carry the relevant invalidation obligations. Physical justification of `DDSound` must be established by a realization consistent with memory layouts and Section 82.

/-- Effect of `depend(result, anchor)` (§64, `ok` effect): `anchor` is added to `D(result)`. -/
def dependEff (s : S3) (q x : Nat) : S3 :=
  { s with D := fun r => if r = q then s.D q ++ [x] else s.D r }

/-- Preconditions of `depend` (§64). The "real dependency" part of §64.2 is not represented;
§64.4 holds by construction (`depsOf`). -/
structure DependPre (s : S3) (q x : Nat) : Prop where
  /-- §64.1: `result` is usable. -/
  usable : s.Usable q
  /-- §64.1: exercisable `Modify` over `result`. -/
  right : HasRight s .modify q
  /-- §64.2: `anchor` is active. -/
  anchorActive : s.Active x
  /-- §64.3: the effective anchor's frame is the frame of `result` or an ancestor. -/
  anchorOrder : EffAnchorOK s x (s.pframe q)

/-- Decidability of the preconditions of `depend` (§64). -/
instance (s : S3) (q x : Nat) : Decidable (DependPre s q x) :=
  decidable_of_iff (s.Usable q ∧ HasRight s .modify q ∧ s.Active x ∧ EffAnchorOK s x (s.pframe q))
    ⟨fun ⟨a, b, c, d⟩ => ⟨a, b, c, d⟩, fun ⟨a, b, c, d⟩ => ⟨a, b, c, d⟩⟩

/-- `depend` as a relation (§64). -/
def DependStep (q x : Nat) (s : S3) : Outcome3 S3 → Prop :=
  Guarded (DependPre s q x) (dependEff s q x)

/-! ## O8 `store` (§65) -/

/-- Effect of `store(authority, target)` (§65, `ok` effect): `target` becomes the holder, the
authority joins `D(target)`, and only leaf `target` becomes `Init`. -/
def storeEff (s : S3) (a p : Nat) : S3 := match s.A[a]? with
  | some y => { s with
      A := s.A.set a { y with holder := .place p }
      D := fun q => if q = p then s.D p ++ [a] else s.D q
      I := fun l => if l = p then .init else s.I l }
  | none => s

/-- Preconditions of `store` (§65). -/
structure StorePre (s : S3) (a p : Nat) : Prop where
  /-- §65.1: the authority is active, derived, and held by the current frame. -/
  derivedHeld : OptP (s.A[a]?) (fun y => y.active = true ∧ y.origin ≠ none ∧
    y.holder = .frame s.top) False
  /-- §65.2: `target` is usable. -/
  usable : s.Usable p
  /-- §65.2: `target` is a leaf. -/
  leaf : isLeaf s.P p
  /-- §65.2: exercisable `Modify` over `target`. -/
  right : HasRight s .modify p
  /-- §65.2: `target` holds no active authority. -/
  free : ∀ j ∈ List.range s.A.length,
    OptP (s.A[j]?) (fun z => z.active = true → z.holder ≠ .place p) True
  /-- §65.3: the authority covers no leaf of `target` nor of storage it owns, transitively. -/
  noCover : ∀ l ∈ s.afp a, l ∉ footprint s.P p ∧
    ∀ q ∈ List.range s.P.length, OwnedIn s.P p q → l ∉ footprint s.P q
  /-- §65.4: the effective anchor respects `AnchorOrder` relative to the frame of `target`. -/
  anchorOrder : EffAnchorOK s a (s.pframe p)
  /-- §65.5: in the resulting state, `target` is under exercisable `Modify`. -/
  keepsTarget : HasRight (storeEff s a p) .modify p
  /-- §65.5: `AnchorOrderHeld` in the resulting state. -/
  anchorOrderHeld : AnchorOrderHeld (storeEff s a p)

/-- Decidability of the preconditions of `store` (§65). -/
instance (s : S3) (a p : Nat) : Decidable (StorePre s a p) :=
  decidable_of_iff (OptP (s.A[a]?) (fun y => y.active = true ∧ y.origin ≠ none ∧
      y.holder = .frame s.top) False ∧ s.Usable p ∧ isLeaf s.P p ∧ HasRight s .modify p ∧
    (∀ j ∈ List.range s.A.length,
      OptP (s.A[j]?) (fun z => z.active = true → z.holder ≠ .place p) True) ∧
    (∀ l ∈ s.afp a, l ∉ footprint s.P p ∧
      ∀ q ∈ List.range s.P.length, OwnedIn s.P p q → l ∉ footprint s.P q) ∧
    EffAnchorOK s a (s.pframe p) ∧ HasRight (storeEff s a p) .modify p ∧
    AnchorOrderHeld (storeEff s a p))
    ⟨fun ⟨a, b, c, d, e, f, g, h, i⟩ => ⟨a, b, c, d, e, f, g, h, i⟩,
     fun ⟨a, b, c, d, e, f, g, h, i⟩ => ⟨a, b, c, d, e, f, g, h, i⟩⟩

/-- `store` as a relation (§65). -/
def StoreStep (a p : Nat) (s : S3) : Outcome3 S3 → Prop :=
  Guarded (StorePre s a p) (storeEff s a p)

/-! ## Shapes (§47, §71.1, §72) -/

/-- A local shape as a shape whose elements have no owning element (§71.1, §72: locals and
allocated storage are owned by the receiving holder). -/
def LocalShape.toShape (ls : LocalShape) : List (Option Nat × Option Nat × Nat) :=
  ls.map fun e => (e.1, none, e.2)

/-- Owner of element `i` of a shape (§47, §72, §71): its owning element if any, `hd`
otherwise. -/
def shapeOwner (ls : List (Option Nat × Option Nat × Nat)) (hd : Holder) (i : Nat) : Holder :=
  match (ls[i]?).bind (·.2.1) with
  | some o => .place o
  | none => hd

/-- Places `P` followed by the elements of a shape (§47, §71, §72): (parent, owning element,
kind), owned by their owning element or by `hd`. -/
def shapeP (P : List Place) (hd : Holder) (ls : List (Option Nat × Option Nat × Nat)) :
    List Place :=
  P ++ (List.range ls.length).map fun i =>
    ⟨(ls[i]?).bind (·.1), shapeOwner ls hd i, ((ls[i]?).map (·.2.2)).getD 0⟩

/-- Well-formed shape at offset `n` (§72.2, §71.1; for statics, the hypothesis recorded for
§47): the parent and the owning element of an element are earlier elements, and a part has the
owning element of its parent. -/
def ShapeOK (n : Nat) (ls : List (Option Nat × Option Nat × Nat)) : Prop :=
  ∀ i ∈ List.range ls.length,
    OptP ((ls[i]?).bind (·.1)) (fun r => n ≤ r ∧ r < n + i ∧
      (ls[i]?).bind (·.2.1) = (ls[r - n]?).bind (·.2.1)) True ∧
    OptP ((ls[i]?).bind (·.2.1)) (fun o => n ≤ o ∧ o < n + i) True

/-- Decidability of `ShapeOK` (§72.2, §71.1). -/
instance (n : Nat) (ls : List (Option Nat × Option Nat × Nat)) : Decidable (ShapeOK n ls) := by
  unfold ShapeOK; infer_instance

/-- Indices of the root elements (no parent) of a shape (§40 root places; §47, §71, §72). -/
def rootIdx (ls : List (Option Nat × Option Nat × Nat)) : List Nat :=
  (List.range ls.length).filter fun i => ((ls[i]?).bind (·.1)).isNone

/-! ## O6 `enterFrame` (§72) -/

/-- Places after `enterFrame` (§72, `ok` effect): the locals appended, owned by the new frame. -/
def enterP (s : S3) (ls : LocalShape) : List Place := shapeP s.P (.frame s.nF) ls.toShape

/-- Effect of `enterFrame(params, locals)` (§72, `ok` effect): a new frame `nF` is pushed; the
parameters are now held by it; locals are appended (uninitialized, no anchor, alive) with one
active root `Modify` authority per root local, held by the new frame; pinning obligations are
unchanged. -/
def enterEff (s : S3) (ps : List Nat) (ls : LocalShape) : S3 :=
  { F := s.nF :: s.F, nF := s.nF + 1, P := enterP s ls
    I := fun l => if s.P.length ≤ l then .uninit else s.I l
    A := mapI (fun j y => if j ∈ ps then { y with holder := .frame s.nF } else y) 0 s.A ++
      (rootIdx ls.toShape).map fun i =>
        ⟨.modify, none, footprint (enterP s ls) (s.P.length + i),
          shapeOwner ls.toShape (.frame s.nF) i, true⟩
    D := fun q => if s.P.length ≤ q then [] else s.D q
    dead := fun q => if s.P.length ≤ q then false else s.dead q
    pins := s.pins }

/-- Origin protection on entry for parameter `p` in state `s'` (§72.3): if `p` is a `Modify`
authority with direct origin `o`, `o` is exercisable in no mode. -/
def ParamOriginHidden (s' : S3) (p : Nat) : Prop :=
  OptP (s'.A[p]?) (fun y => y.mode = .modify →
    OptP y.origin (fun o => ¬ s'.ExercisableAt o .observe ∧ ¬ s'.ExercisableAt o .modify) True) True

/-- Decidability of `ParamOriginHidden` (§72.3). -/
instance (s' : S3) (p : Nat) : Decidable (ParamOriginHidden s' p) := by
  unfold ParamOriginHidden; infer_instance

/-- Preconditions of `enterFrame` (§72). The modes/footprints/parameter-passing part of §72.2 is
not represented. -/
structure EnterPre (s : S3) (ps : List Nat) (ls : LocalShape) : Prop where
  /-- §72.1: the calling frame, the current frame, is live. -/
  callerLive : s.F ≠ []
  /-- §72.1: each parameter is an active derived authority held by the caller. -/
  params : ∀ a ∈ ps, OptP (s.A[a]?) (fun y => y.active = true ∧ y.holder = .frame s.top ∧
    y.origin ≠ none) False
  /-- §72.2: the locals form a well-formed shape (each parent is an earlier local). -/
  localsOK : ShapeOK s.P.length ls.toShape
  /-- §72.3: origin protection on entry, in the resulting state. -/
  originHidden : ∀ p ∈ ps, ParamOriginHidden (enterEff s ps ls) p
  /-- §72.4: `AnchorOrderHeld` over the resulting state. -/
  anchorOrderHeld : AnchorOrderHeld (enterEff s ps ls)

/-- Decidability of the preconditions of `enterFrame` (§72). -/
instance (s : S3) (ps : List Nat) (ls : LocalShape) : Decidable (EnterPre s ps ls) :=
  decidable_of_iff (s.F ≠ [] ∧ (∀ a ∈ ps, OptP (s.A[a]?) (fun y => y.active = true ∧
      y.holder = .frame s.top ∧ y.origin ≠ none) False) ∧ ShapeOK s.P.length ls.toShape ∧
    (∀ p ∈ ps, ParamOriginHidden (enterEff s ps ls) p) ∧ AnchorOrderHeld (enterEff s ps ls))
    ⟨fun ⟨a, b, c, d, e⟩ => ⟨a, b, c, d, e⟩, fun ⟨a, b, c, d, e⟩ => ⟨a, b, c, d, e⟩⟩

/-- `enterFrame` as a relation (§72). -/
def EnterStep (ps : List Nat) (ls : LocalShape) (s : S3) : Outcome3 S3 → Prop :=
  Guarded (EnterPre s ps ls) (enterEff s ps ls)

/-! ## O7 `exitFrame` (§73) -/

/-- Authority `x` survives the exit to stack `F₀` (§73.4): active and held by a surviving frame
or by a usable place whose terminal owner survives. -/
def Survives (s : S3) (F₀ : Frames) (x : Nat) : Prop :=
  OptP (s.A[x]?) (fun y => y.active = true ∧ HolderLive { s with F := F₀ } y.holder) False

/-- Decidability of `Survives` (§73.4). -/
instance (s : S3) (F₀ : Frames) (x : Nat) : Decidable (Survives s F₀ x) := by
  unfold Survives; infer_instance

/-- First surviving authority of a list (§73.4). -/
def firstSurv (s : S3) (F₀ : Frames) (l : List Nat) : Option Nat :=
  l.find? fun z => decide (Survives s F₀ z)

/-- Authority `a` after the exit (§73, `ok` effect): released unless it survives; a surviving
derived authority is reanchored to the first surviving active origin of its chain. -/
def exitG (s : S3) (F₀ : Frames) (a : Nat) (y : Authority) : Authority :=
  if Survives s F₀ a then
    match y.origin with
    | none => y
    | some _ => { y with origin := firstSurv s F₀ (s.ancs a) }
  else { y with active := false }

/-- Effect of `exitFrame` (§73, `ok` effect): the current frame is popped; authorities that do
not survive are released; surviving derived authorities and the anchors of `D` are reanchored to
the first surviving authority of their chains. -/
def exitEff (s : S3) : S3 :=
  { s with
    F := s.F.tail
    D := fun q => (s.D q).map fun x => (firstSurv s s.F.tail (x :: s.ancs x)).getD x
    A := mapI (exitG s s.F.tail) 0 s.A }

/-- Preconditions of `exitFrame` (§73). The result clause of §73.2 is not represented. -/
structure ExitPre (k : K) (s : S3) : Prop where
  /-- §73.1: the current frame is not the initial frame and has a surviving caller. -/
  hasCaller : s.F.tail ≠ []
  /-- §73.2, §73.4, §73.5: every anchor of a place usable after the exit has a surviving
  authority among itself and its origins. -/
  anchors : ∀ q ∈ List.range s.P.length, ({ s with F := s.F.tail } : S3).Usable q →
    ∀ x ∈ s.D q, firstSurv s s.F.tail (x :: s.ancs x) ≠ none
  /-- §73.4: every surviving derived authority has a surviving active origin. -/
  origins : ∀ a ∈ List.range s.A.length, Survives s s.F.tail a → s.org a ≠ none →
    firstSurv s s.F.tail (s.ancs a) ≠ none
  /-- §73.3: no leaf of a place that dies with the frame is pinned, statically or
  dynamically. -/
  notPinned : ∀ q ∈ List.range s.P.length, s.Usable q →
    ¬ ({ s with F := s.F.tail } : S3).Usable q →
    ∀ l ∈ footprint s.P q, s.pin l = false ∧ ¬ k.Pinned l
  /-- §73.5: `AnchorOrderHeld` in the resulting state. -/
  anchorOrderHeld : AnchorOrderHeld (exitEff s)

/-- Decidability of the preconditions of `exitFrame` (§73). -/
instance (k : K) [DecidablePred k.Pinned] (s : S3) : Decidable (ExitPre k s) :=
  decidable_of_iff (s.F.tail ≠ [] ∧
    (∀ q ∈ List.range s.P.length, ({ s with F := s.F.tail } : S3).Usable q →
      ∀ x ∈ s.D q, firstSurv s s.F.tail (x :: s.ancs x) ≠ none) ∧
    (∀ a ∈ List.range s.A.length, Survives s s.F.tail a → s.org a ≠ none →
      firstSurv s s.F.tail (s.ancs a) ≠ none) ∧
    (∀ q ∈ List.range s.P.length, s.Usable q → ¬ ({ s with F := s.F.tail } : S3).Usable q →
      ∀ l ∈ footprint s.P q, s.pin l = false ∧ ¬ k.Pinned l) ∧
    AnchorOrderHeld (exitEff s))
    ⟨fun ⟨a, b, c, d, e⟩ => ⟨a, b, c, d, e⟩, fun ⟨a, b, c, d, e⟩ => ⟨a, b, c, d, e⟩⟩

/-- `exitFrame` as a relation (§73). -/
def ExitStep (k : K) (s : S3) : Outcome3 S3 → Prop := Guarded (ExitPre k s) (exitEff s)

/-! ## O9 `read`, O10 `write`, O11 `writeShared` (§66–§68) -/

/-- Leaf `l` belongs to a usable place (§66.1, §67.1, §68.1). -/
def LeafOfUsable (s : S3) (l : Nat) : Prop :=
  ∃ q ∈ List.range s.P.length, s.Usable q ∧ l ∈ footprint s.P q

/-- Decidability of `LeafOfUsable` (§66.1). -/
instance (s : S3) (l : Nat) : Decidable (LeafOfUsable s l) := by
  unfold LeafOfUsable; infer_instance

/-- Preconditions of `read` of the leaves `ls` through `access` (§66). The type and storage
contract of §66.3 is not represented. -/

/-- Neither step changes the bottom of the stack (§39: the base frame never exits):
`enterFrame` pushes the new frame on top. -/
theorem enter_keeps_base {s s' : S3} {ps : List Nat} {ls : LocalShape}
    (h : EnterStep ps ls s (.ok s')) : s'.F.getLast? = s.F.getLast? := by
  obtain ⟨hpre, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 h
  exact getLast?_cons_ne hpre.callerLive

/-- An exited frame leaves the stack and is the terminal owner of no usable place (§39, §73 `ok`
effect, first item). -/
theorem exitFrame_frame_gone {k : K} {s s' : S3} (hw : WF3 s) (h : ExitStep k s (.ok s')) :
    s.top ∉ s'.F ∧ ∀ q, s'.Usable q → ¬ FrameOf s' q s.top := by
  obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 h
  obtain ⟨f, F₀, hF⟩ : ∃ f F₀, s.F = f :: F₀ := by
    cases h : s.F with
    | nil => exact absurd h hw.frames.1
    | cons f F₀ => exact ⟨f, F₀, rfl⟩
  have hnd := (List.nodup_cons.1 (hF ▸ hw.frames.2.1)).1
  have htop : s.top = f := by simp [S3.top, hF]
  have hF' : (exitEff s).F = F₀ := by simp [exitEff, hF]
  rw [htop, hF']
  refine ⟨hnd, fun q hq hfq => ?_⟩
  obtain ⟨g, hg, hgF⟩ := hq.frameOf
  have e := FrameOf.det hfq hg
  rw [hF', ← e] at hgF
  exact hnd hgF

/-! ## Release at the exit (§73 `ok` effect, §39, §45) -/

/-- `exitFrame_releases_all` (§73 `ok` effect, second item; §39; §45): after an `ok` exit, an
authority held by the exited frame or by a place that is no longer usable is released, with its
holder unchanged (it is not returned to the caller); every active authority has a live holder,
other than the exited frame. -/
theorem exitFrame_releases_all {k : K} {s s' : S3} (hw : WF3 s) (h : ExitStep k s (.ok s')) :
    (∀ (j : Nat) (y : Authority), s.A[j]? = some y →
      (y.holder = .frame s.top ∨ ∃ p, y.holder = .place p ∧ ¬ s'.Usable p) →
      ∃ y', s'.A[j]? = some y' ∧ y'.active = false ∧ y'.holder = y.holder) ∧
    (∀ (j : Nat) (y : Authority), s'.A[j]? = some y → y.active = true →
      HolderLive s' y.holder ∧ y.holder ≠ .frame s.top) := by
  obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 h
  obtain ⟨f, F₀, hF⟩ : ∃ f F₀, s.F = f :: F₀ := by
    cases h : s.F with
    | nil => exact absurd h hw.frames.1
    | cons f F₀ => exact ⟨f, F₀, rfl⟩
  have hnd := (List.nodup_cons.1 (hF ▸ hw.frames.2.1)).1
  have htop : s.top = f := by simp [S3.top, hF]
  have hlive : ∀ hd, HolderLive (exitEff s) hd ↔ HolderLive ({ s with F := s.F.tail } : S3) hd :=
    HolderLive.congr (s := ({ s with F := s.F.tail } : S3)) (s' := exitEff s) rfl rfl rfl
  have hnot : ¬ HolderLive ({ s with F := s.F.tail } : S3) (.frame f) := by
    show f ∉ s.F.tail; rw [hF]; exact hnd
  refine ⟨fun j y hy hh => ?_, fun j y hy ya => ?_⟩
  · have hns : ¬ Survives s s.F.tail j := by
      unfold Survives; rw [hy]; rintro ⟨-, hl⟩
      rcases hh with e | ⟨p, e, hp⟩
      · rw [e, htop] at hl; exact hnot hl
      · rw [e] at hl; exact hp ((hlive (.place p)).2 hl)
    refine ⟨_, by rw [Frames.exit_A_get, hy]; rfl, by simp [exitG, hns], by simp [exitG, hns]⟩
  · obtain ⟨y₀, hy₀, rfl⟩ := Frames.exit_get hy
    have hs := Frames.exitG_active ya
    unfold Survives at hs; rw [hy₀] at hs
    have hl : HolderLive ({ s with F := s.F.tail } : S3) y₀.holder := hs.2
    rw [(Frames.exitG_same s s.F.tail j y₀).2.2]
    refine ⟨(hlive _).2 hl, fun e => ?_⟩
    rw [e, htop] at hl; exact hnot hl

/-! ## No dangling authority after the exit (§73, §54) -/

/-- `exitFrame_no_dangling` (§73, §54): from a state satisfying `WF3` (§49), `I1` (§50) and
`NoDangling` (§54), clauses of §57, after an `ok` exit no active authority covers a leaf of a
place that is not usable, in particular of a local of the exited frame or of storage dying with
it. -/
theorem exitFrame_no_dangling {k : K} {s s' : S3} (hw : WF3 s) (h1 : I1 s) (hnd : NoDangling s)
    (h : ExitStep k s (.ok s')) :
    ∀ q, ¬ s'.Usable q → ∀ (j : Nat) (y : Authority), s'.A[j]? = some y → y.active = true →
      ∀ l ∈ footprint s'.P q, l ∉ y.footprint := by
  obtain ⟨hpre, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 h
  intro q hq j y hy ya
  exact Frames.exit_noDangling hw h1 hnd hpre.origins j y hy ya q hq

/-! ## Reanchoring at the exit (§73.4, §73 `ok` effect, §45) -/

/-- Reanchoring (§73.4; §73 `ok` effect, third and fourth items; §45): after an `ok` exit, a
surviving authority stays active with its own mode, footprint and holder; it keeps no origin if
it had none; otherwise its origin becomes the first surviving active origin of its chain: no
earlier ancestor survives, and that origin is active and held, after the exit, by a frame of the
stack or by a usable place. -/
theorem exitFrame_reanchors {k : K} {s s' : S3} (h : ExitStep k s (.ok s')) {a : Nat}
    {y : Authority} (hy : s.A[a]? = some y) (hs : Survives s s.F.tail a) :
    ∃ y', s'.A[a]? = some y' ∧ y'.active = true ∧ y'.mode = y.mode ∧
      y'.footprint = y.footprint ∧ y'.holder = y.holder ∧
      (y.origin = none → y'.origin = none) ∧
      (y.origin ≠ none → ∃ (z : Nat) (pre post : List Nat) (yz : Authority),
        y'.origin = some z ∧ s.ancs a = pre ++ z :: post ∧
        (∀ w ∈ pre, ¬ Survives s s.F.tail w) ∧
        s'.A[z]? = some yz ∧ yz.active = true ∧ HolderLive s' yz.holder) := by
  obtain ⟨hpre, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 h
  have hlive : ∀ hd, HolderLive (exitEff s) hd ↔ HolderLive ({ s with F := s.F.tail } : S3) hd :=
    HolderLive.congr (s := ({ s with F := s.F.tail } : S3)) (s' := exitEff s) rfl rfl rfl
  obtain ⟨ym, yf, yh⟩ := Frames.exitG_same s s.F.tail a y
  refine ⟨_, by rw [Frames.exit_A_get, hy]; rfl, Frames.exitG_surv hy hs, ym, yf, yh,
    fun ho => by simp [exitG, hs, ho], fun ho => ?_⟩
  have horg : s.org a ≠ none := by simpa [S3.org, hy] using ho
  obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ := Option.ne_none_iff_exists'.1
    (hpre.origins a (List.mem_range.2 (lt_of_getElem? hy)) hs horg)
  obtain ⟨-, pre, post, hl, hpre'⟩ := List.find?_eq_some_iff_append.1 hz
  obtain ⟨-, hzs⟩ := Frames.firstSurv_some hz
  have hzs' := hzs
  unfold Survives OptP at hzs'
  split at hzs'
  · rename_i yz hyz
    refine ⟨z, pre, post, _, ?_, hl, fun w hw => by simpa using hpre' w hw,
      by rw [Frames.exit_A_get, hyz]; rfl, Frames.exitG_surv hyz hzs, ?_⟩
    · obtain ⟨o, ho'⟩ := Option.ne_none_iff_exists'.1 ho
      simp [exitG, hs, ho', hz]
    · rw [(Frames.exitG_same s s.F.tail z yz).2.2]; exact (hlive _).2 hzs'.2
  · exact hzs'.elim

/-- Reanchoring of anchors (§73 `ok` effect, third item; §73.5): after an `ok` exit, every anchor
of a usable place is replaced by the first surviving authority among itself and its origins,
which is an anchor of the place after the exit and is active. -/
theorem exitFrame_reanchors_anchors {k : K} {s s' : S3} (h : ExitStep k s (.ok s')) :
    ∀ q, s'.Usable q → ∀ x ∈ s.D q, ∃ z, firstSurv s s.F.tail (x :: s.ancs x) = some z ∧
      (z = x ∨ z ∈ s.ancs x) ∧ z ∈ s'.D q ∧ s'.Active z := by
  obtain ⟨hpre, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 h
  intro q hq x hx
  have hq₁ : ({ s with F := s.F.tail } : S3).Usable q := Frames.exit_usable_iff.1 hq
  have hne := hpre.anchors q (List.mem_range.2 (Frames.usable_of_tail hq₁).lt) hq₁ x hx
  obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ := Option.ne_none_iff_exists'.1 hne
  obtain ⟨hzm, hzs⟩ := Frames.firstSurv_some hz
  have hmem : z ∈ (exitEff s).D q := List.mem_map.2 ⟨x, hx, by simp [hz]⟩
  refine ⟨z, hz, List.mem_cons.1 hzm, hmem, ?_⟩
  have hzs' := hzs
  unfold Survives OptP at hzs'
  split at hzs'
  · rename_i yz hyz
    exact ⟨_, by rw [Frames.exit_A_get, hyz]; rfl, Frames.exitG_surv hyz hzs⟩
  · exact hzs'.elim

/-! ## Parameters (§45, §72) -/

/-- The caller yields its parameters (§45; §72 `ok` effect): after an `ok` entry the new frame is
the current frame, it holds every parameter, the other existing authorities are unchanged, and
every new authority is the root authority (no origin) of a root local, held by the new frame, so
the caller keeps no copy of a parameter. -/
theorem enter_yields {s s' : S3} {ps : List Nat} {ls : LocalShape} (hw : WF3 s)
    (h : EnterStep ps ls s (.ok s')) :
    s'.top = s.nF ∧ s.nF ∉ s.F ∧ s'.F = s.nF :: s.F ∧
    (∀ j < s.A.length, s'.A[j]? =
      (s.A[j]?).map fun y => if j ∈ ps then { y with holder := .frame s'.top } else y) ∧
    (∀ (j : Nat) (y : Authority), s.A.length ≤ j → s'.A[j]? = some y →
      y.origin = none ∧ y.holder = .frame s'.top) := by
  obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 h
  have htop : (enterEff s ps ls).top = s.nF := rfl
  refine ⟨htop, ?_, rfl, fun j hj => by rw [htop]; exact Frames.enter_lt hj,
    fun j y hj hy => ?_⟩
  · exact fun hm => Nat.lt_irrefl _ (hw.frames.2.2 _ hm)
  · rcases Frames.enter_get hy with ⟨hj', -⟩ | ⟨-, i, -, rfl⟩
    · omega
    · exact ⟨rfl, rfl⟩

/-- An active `Modify` authority takes every effective mode, on each of its leaves, away from its
direct origin (§43 case 3; last paragraph of §72: while a `Modify` parameter remains active, its
direct origin remains subject to effective-mode restrictions). -/
theorem param_origin_restricted {s : S3} (hw : WF3 s) {p o l : Nat} {y : Authority}
    (hp : s.A[p]? = some y) (ya : y.active = true) (hm : y.mode = .modify)
    (ho : y.origin = some o) (hl : l ∈ y.footprint) : effective s o l = none := by
  have hop : s.org p = some o := by simp [S3.org, hp, ho]
  have hoa : o ∈ s.ancs p := by
    rw [S3.ancs, chain_cons hop (hw.origins p y o hp ho)]; exact List.mem_cons_self ..
  have hd : Mode.modify ∈ descModes s o l := mem_descModes.2 ⟨p, y, hp, ya, hl, hoa, hm⟩
  unfold effective
  split
  · split
    · unfold effOf
      have hne : descModes s o l ≠ [] := fun e => by rw [e] at hd; cases hd
      simp [hne, hd]
    · rfl
  · rfl

/-- While an active `Modify` authority `p` covers a leaf, every authority with a present
effective mode on that leaf is `p` or one of its descendants (§50 `I1`, §43; last paragraph of
§72 for a `Modify` parameter). -/
theorem call_params_effective_protected {s : S3} (h1 : I1 s) {p b l : Nat} {y : Authority}
    (hp : s.A[p]? = some y) (ya : y.active = true) (hm : y.mode = .modify) (hl : l ∈ y.footprint)
    (hb : effective s b l ≠ none) : b = p ∨ p ∈ s.ancs b := by
  by_cases e : b = p
  · exact .inl e
  by_cases hpb : p ∈ s.ancs b
  · exact .inr hpb
  cases he : effective s b l with
  | none => exact absurd he hb
  | some mb =>
    obtain ⟨x, hx, xa, xl, ex⟩ := effective_some he
    by_cases hbp : b ∈ s.ancs p
    · have hd : Mode.modify ∈ descModes s b l := mem_descModes.2 ⟨p, y, hp, ya, hl, hbp, hm⟩
      rcases effOf_cases ex with ⟨h0, -⟩ | ⟨-, hn, -⟩
      · simp [h0] at hd
      · exact absurd hd hn
    · have := (h1 b p x y l e hx hp xa ya xl hl hbp hpb).2
      rw [hm] at this; cases this

/-- `enter_params_protected` (§72.3; last paragraph of §72): after an `ok` entry, the direct
origin of each `Modify` parameter is exercisable in no mode, and on each leaf of a `Modify`
parameter every authority with a present effective mode is the parameter or one of its
descendants, so its direct origin has no effective mode there. -/
theorem enter_params_protected {s s' : S3} {ps : List Nat} {ls : LocalShape} (hwf : WF3 s)
    (h1 : I1 s) (h : EnterStep ps ls s (.ok s')) :
    (∀ p ∈ ps, ParamOriginHidden s' p) ∧
      ∀ p ∈ ps, ∀ y : Authority, s'.A[p]? = some y → y.mode = .modify → ∀ l ∈ y.footprint,
        (∀ b, effective s' b l ≠ none → b = p ∨ p ∈ s'.ancs b) ∧
        ∀ o, y.origin = some o → effective s' o l = none := by
  obtain ⟨hpre, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 h
  have hi1 := Frames.enter_i1 hwf h1 (ps := ps) (ls := ls)
  have hwf' := Frames.enter_wf hwf hpre
  refine ⟨hpre.originHidden, fun p hp y hy hm l hl => ?_⟩
  have ya : y.active = true := by
    have h2 := hpre.params p hp
    unfold OptP at h2; split at h2
    · rename_i y₀ hy₀
      rw [Frames.enter_lt (lt_of_getElem? hy₀), hy₀] at hy
      simp only [Option.map_some, Option.some.injEq] at hy
      subst hy; split <;> exact h2.1
    · exact h2.elim
  exact ⟨fun b hb => call_params_effective_protected hi1 hy ya hm hl hb,
    fun o ho => param_origin_restricted hwf' hy ya hm ho hl⟩

/-! ## Witness: reanchoring to an origin held by a place (§73.4) -/

namespace Frames.Witness

open Examples

/-- After `derive(0, [0], Modify)` (authority 3) and `store(3, 1)` (§60, §65): authority 3 is
held by static place 1. -/
def w2 : S3 := storeEff s1 3 1
/-- After `derive(3, [0], Modify)` (§60): authority 4, held by frame 0. -/
def w3 : S3 := deriveEff w2 3 [0] .modify
/-- After `derive(2, [2], Modify)` (§60): authority 5, held by frame 0. -/
def w4 : S3 := deriveEff w3 2 [2] .modify
/-- After `enterFrame([4, 5], [])` (§72): frame 1 holds parameters 4 and 5. -/
def w5 : S3 := enterEff w4 [4, 5] []
/-- After `derive(4, [0], Modify)` (§60): authority 6, held by frame 1. -/
def w6 : S3 := deriveEff w5 4 [0] .modify
/-- After `store(6, 2)` (§65): authority 6 is held by static place 2, owned by frame 0. -/
def w7 : S3 := storeEff w6 6 2

/-- The state `w7` is reachable from `S3.init st` (§57). -/
theorem w7_reachable : Reachable K0 st w7 :=
  .step (.step (.step (.step (.step (.step (.step .init
    (.derive (.ok (by decide : DerivePre s0 0 [0] .modify))))
    (.store (.ok (by decide : StorePre s1 3 1))))
    (.derive (.ok (by decide : DerivePre w2 3 [0] .modify))))
    (.derive (.ok (by decide : DerivePre w3 2 [2] .modify))))
    (.enter (.ok (by decide : EnterPre w4 [4, 5] []))))
    (.derive (.ok (by decide : DerivePre w5 4 [0] .modify))))
    (.store (.ok (by decide : StorePre w6 6 2)))

/-- Witness for §73.4 (a surviving origin is not skipped because it is held by a place): from
the reachable state `w7`, `exitFrame` is `ok`; authority 6 (held by place 2) survives; its
direct origin 4, held by the exiting frame, does not survive; it is reanchored to authority 3,
the next origin of its chain, which is active and held by the usable place 1, rather than to the
root authority 0. -/
theorem exit_reanchors_to_place_witness :
    Reachable K0 st w7 ∧ ExitStep K0 w7 (.ok (exitEff w7)) ∧
      w7.org 6 = some 4 ∧ w7.org 4 = some 3 ∧ w7.org 3 = some 0 ∧
      Survives w7 w7.F.tail 6 ∧ ¬ Survives w7 w7.F.tail 4 ∧
      (exitEff w7).org 6 = some 3 ∧
      OptP ((exitEff w7).A[3]?) (fun z => z.active = true ∧ z.holder = .place 1) False ∧
      (exitEff w7).Usable 1 :=
  ⟨w7_reachable, .ok (by decide), by decide, by decide, by decide, by decide, by decide,
    by decide, by decide, by decide⟩

end Frames.Witness

/-- `effective_exclusive` (§50): under `I1`, an authority with effective `Modify` on a leaf is the
only one with a present effective mode there. -/
theorem effective_exclusive {s : S3} (h : I1 s) {a b p : Nat} (hab : a ≠ b)
    (ha : effective s a p = some .modify) : effective s b p = none := by
  cases hb : effective s b p with
  | none => rfl
  | some m => exact absurd (effective_compat h a b p _ _ hab ha hb).1 (by simp)

/-- Compatibility of effective modes is symmetric (§50). -/
theorem Compat.symm {m₁ m₂ : Mode} (h : Compat m₁ m₂) : Compat m₂ m₁ := ⟨h.2, h.1⟩

/-- `I4` holds in every state (§53, first sentence): a read requires `Init` on every leaf read
(§66.1). -/
theorem i4_always (s : S3) : I4 s := fun _ _ l hl hm h => by rw [h.init l hl] at hm; cases hm

/-! ## Consequences of `I2` (§51) -/

/-- Under `I2`, the origin of an active derived authority is active (§51). -/
theorem I2.origin_active {s : S3} (h2 : I2 s) {b a : Nat} {y : Authority}
    (hb : s.A[b]? = some y) (ho : y.origin = some a) (ya : y.active = true) : s.Active a := by
  obtain ⟨x, hx, -, -, hxa⟩ := h2 b y a hb ho; exact ⟨x, hx, hxa ya⟩

/-- Under `I2`, every authority of the origin chain of an active authority below `n` is active
(§51; §44, §60.1). -/
theorem I2.ancs_active_lt {s : S3} (h2 : I2 s) :
    ∀ n j, j < n → s.Active j → ∀ x ∈ s.ancs j, s.Active x
  | 0, _, h, _, _, _ => absurd h (Nat.not_lt_zero _)
  | n + 1, j, hj, ⟨y, hy, ya⟩, x, hx => by
    obtain ⟨o, ho, hlt, hx⟩ := mem_chain hx
    have hoa : s.Active o := h2.origin_active hy (by simpa [S3.org, hy] using ho) ya
    rcases hx with rfl | hx
    · exact hoa
    · exact I2.ancs_active_lt h2 n o (by omega) hoa x hx

/-- Under `I2`, every authority of the origin chain of an active authority, its effective anchor
included, is active (§51; §44, §60.1). -/
theorem I2.ancs_active {s : S3} (h2 : I2 s) {j : Nat} (hj : s.Active j) :
    ∀ x ∈ s.ancs j, s.Active x :=
  h2.ancs_active_lt (j + 1) j (Nat.lt_succ_self j) hj

/-! ## Additions of authorities (§42, §60, §61) -/

/-- A list whose members are none is empty (§43, §63.2). -/
theorem nil_of_forall_not_mem {α : Type} : ∀ {l : List α}, (∀ a, a ∉ l) → l = []
  | [], _ => rfl
